value.description: The wheel's color, when the caller controls it. The wheel edits its hue and keeps the rest.

defaultValue.description: The starting color, when the wheel controls itself.

outerRadius.description: The wheel's outer radius in pixels: the wheel is twice this wide and tall. It must be a finite number of 0 or more, and more than innerRadius.

innerRadius.description: The radius of the hole in the middle, in pixels. It must be a finite number of 0 or more, and less than outerRadius.

disabled.description: Disables the wheel: it can be neither focused nor changed. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

readOnly.description: Makes the wheel read-only: it stays focusable but its hue cannot be changed. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

change.description: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time the hue changes. It is in the color space of the value, of the enclosing ColorPicker, or of defaultValue, and in hsla() form with none of them. A disabled or read-only wheel does not call it.

MuxUIColorValue.description: A CSS color string. A color control's onChange returns one in the color space of its value, of an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or of its defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and rgb, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for hsl and hsb. ColorSlider with colorSpace uses that space, and ColorSwatchPicker returns the chosen item's color.
